message.potato_s_t.starfall.cancelled: The starfall has been called off
message.potato_s_t.starfall.incoming: ⚠ A meteor is falling toward %s %s - look up
message.potato_s_t.starfall.locked: Locked in - it can no longer be cancelled
message.potato_s_t.starfall.started: The starfall is gathering: impact in 30 s; right-click again within 10 s to cancel
message.potato_s_t.starfall.warning: ⚠ %s's starfall is locked on %s %s %s - get away from there!
tooltip.potato_s_t.power_capturer:
Watches all 6 neighbouring faces and squeezes power out of whatever it finds: flowing water, or a furnace, blast furnace or smoker with a fire still going.
+8 power per block of flowing water, +8 for a furnace or smoker, +16 for a blast furnace.
(The romance of the waterwheel and the blast furnace lives in this one block.)
tooltip.potato_s_t.generator:
Turns power into electricity at 2 FE/t per point of power.
Where does power come from? See the <Power Capturer>. It will not make you rich, but it will make you electricity.
tooltip.potato_s_t.lithium_battery:
Stores 4M FE per block. Batteries placed edge to edge in a solid cuboid merge into a single multiblock automatically (2x2 up to 6 layers; 2x3 / 3x3 / 3x4 up to 12 layers; 4x4 / 5x5 up to 32 layers). Only the top face accepts a Terminal Block.
Right-click with a battery to tile a whole layer, right-click again to stack another layer above or below; sneak-right-click to place a single block.
message.potato_s_t.terminal_selected: Terminal selected! Right-click a second terminal to link them
message.potato_s_t.terminal_too_far: Too far! The longest link is %s blocks. Electricity has its limits
message.potato_s_t.terminal_already_conn: Those two terminals are already connected
message.potato_s_t.terminal_missing: The terminal you picked earlier is gone. Pick again
message.potato_s_t.battery_not_formed: Not formed: it needs a solid cuboid (2x2 up to 6 layers; 2x3 / 3x3 / 3x4 up to 12 layers; 4x4 / 5x5 up to 32 layers)
message.potato_s_t.battery_layer_blocked: Placement failed: something is in the way
message.potato_s_t.battery_layer_no_room: Placement failed: this base is already at its ceiling (%s layers)
message.potato_s_t.battery_base_invalid: Placement failed: that base shape is not allowed (2x2, 2x3, 3x3, 3x4, 4x4, 5x5 only)
message.potato_s_t.battery_single_no_sta: A single battery will not stack: lay down a base of at least 2x2 first
tooltip.potato_s_t.electrolyzer:
No electrolyte: burns 1000 FE and 10 mB of water per tick, yields 3 Oxygen + 6 Hydrogen.
Drop a piece of Sea Salt into the electrolyte slot and it switches to Chlorine: same power and water, 3 Chlorine + 6 Hydrogen, but one Sea Salt per 500 mB of water.
If a tank fills up, the water runs dry or the power cuts out, it quietly stops and waits.
tooltip.potato_s_t.fluid_exchanger:
Left slot: an oil bucket or gas tank with fluid in it. Right slot: exactly 1 empty bucket.
After 3 seconds it draws out 1000 mB and that empty bucket turns into the bucket of that fluid on the spot (water -> Water Bucket, diesel -> Diesel Bucket; fluids from other mods work too, as long as they have a bucket of their own).
Fluids with no bucket form (crude oil / naphtha / LPG) are refused outright.
For gases (gas tank) hook up a Fluid Pump: it drains the container directly, as much as there is.
gui.potato_s_t.fluid_exchanger.status.em: [Fluid Exchanger] Left slot is empty (or the container holds nothing)
gui.potato_s_t.fluid_exchanger.status.in: [Fluid Exchanger] That thing in the left slot is not a fluid container - use an oil bucket or a gas tank
gui.potato_s_t.fluid_exchanger.status.ou: [Fluid Exchanger] The right slot needs exactly 1 empty bucket - it becomes that fluid's bucket right there
gui.potato_s_t.fluid_exchanger.status.ma: [Fluid Exchanger] Less than 1000 mB in the left slot - it starts on its own once there is enough, progress kept
gui.potato_s_t.fluid_exchanger.status.no: [Fluid Exchanger] This fluid has no bucket (crude oil / naphtha / LPG live only in oil buckets)
gui.potato_s_t.fluid_exchanger.status.ga: [Fluid Exchanger] The left slot holds a gas - the GUI does not deal with gases, hook up a Fluid Pump
tooltip.potato_s_t.distillation_controll:
Structure 4x4x7, 7 layers:
- Layers 1-2: Common Metal Block on the four corners
- Layers 3 / 5: corners = Common Metal Block, edges = Heat-Resistant Metal Block, centre 2x2 = Heater
- Layers 4 / 6: a ring of Heat-Resistant Metal Block (hollow)
- Layer 7: 4x4 of Common Metal Block
- Every cell drawn empty on the blueprint must be air
Scan range: 32x32x10 around itself. It counts the towers and reports the number to an adjacent Operator.
tooltip.potato_s_t.distillation_operator:
Per tower, per tick: 8 mB crude oil + 8096 FE -> 3 Diesel + 2 Naphtha + 2 Gasoline + 1 LPG
Every 5 ticks: 1 Bitumen per tower. Pile up 64 with nobody collecting and it stops.
Per tower: 12 buckets of oil, 2.5 buckets of each product
Needs a redstone signal to start; recognises up to 4 towers.
gui.potato_s_t.distillation.diagnosis.fo: Detected %s distillation tower(s) - up to 4 are recognised
gui.potato_s_t.distillation.diagnosis.no: No tower found: the closest candidate is wrong in %s of 112 cells - layer %s, row %s, column %s (at %s) should be '%s' but is '%s'
gui.potato_s_t.distillation.diagnosis.em: Nothing within 32x32x10 looks like a distillation tower (start with the four corners of layer 1)
gui.potato_s_t.distillation.pour.rejecte: Cannot pour %s in (crude oil only; it may also be a full tank / the wrong fluid / no tower detected yet (capacity 0))
tooltip.potato_s_t.oil_bucket.rule: One liquid only - a different fluid or a gas will not go in
tooltip.potato_s_t.sea_salt: Sea salt dried out of seawater. Drop it in water and it dissolves away - do try not to fumble it at the shoreline
tooltip.potato_s_t.salt_dryer:
In an ocean or salty river biome, at Y 0-64 and with a water source below, it produces 1 Sea Salt every 120 seconds.
Feed it FE (70 FE/t) and that drops to one every 20 seconds. Sunshine is free, but electricity is faster.
gui.potato_s_t.salt_dryer.reason.biome: Must be in an ocean or salty river biome
tooltip.potato_s_t.fluid_pump:
Front face is the input, back face is the output; pipes attach to those two faces only.
The pump stores no fluid itself - whatever it pulls out leaves immediately.
It only moves fluids the destination accepts; anything refused is not touched at all.
Right-click for the rate (0% - 800%).
tooltip.potato_s_t.high_pressure_tank.hy: ⚠ Hydrogen has reached %s mB: DANGER! Keep away from open flames! DANGER! (Important things bear repeating)
tooltip.potato_s_t.filling_machine:
Fills container items from its five internal tanks (5000 mB each, 5 mB/t, 60 FE/t for each tank actually working, 3000 FE buffer).
Right-click the machine with an oil bucket or gas tank to pour in; sneak-right-click empty-handed for a per-slot diagnosis that tells you exactly what is missing.
gui.potato_s_t.filling.pour.noroom: Cannot pour in: all five tanks are full, or they already hold other fluids (one fluid per tank)
gui.potato_s_t.filling.diag.tank_empty: [Filling Machine] Slot %s: its tank is empty - nothing to fill (right-click the machine with a container to pour)
gui.potato_s_t.filling.diag.slot_empty: [Filling Machine] Slot %s: no container in the slot - put a gas tank or an oil bucket here
gui.potato_s_t.filling.diag.full: [Filling Machine] Slot %s: the container is already full
gui.potato_s_t.filling.diag.no_power: [Filling Machine] Slot %s: no power - only %s FE in the machine, each slot wants %s FE/t
gui.potato_s_t.filling.diag.rejected: [Filling Machine] Slot %s: this container will not take the tank's fluid (tank holds %s)
gui.potato_s_t.filling.diag.filling: [Filling Machine] Slot %s: filling - tank holds %s %s mB, container has %s mB of room
gui.potato_s_t.jei.per_salt: Consumes 1 Sea Salt per %s mB of water
tooltip.potato_s_t.solar_panel:
Generates power in daylight only, strongest around noon (see JEI for the hour-by-hour numbers).
Rain cuts it to 60% and a thunderstorm to 20% - in bad weather it would rather be excused.
The block directly above must be air or colorless glass.
Stores 512 FE and feeds the block below automatically.
Horizontally adjacent panels link up on their own, sharing generation and storage across the whole group.
message.potato_s_t.solar_status: Solar panels linked: %s, %s FE/t in total
message.potato_s_t.solar_pool: Shared storage %s / %s FE (this panel buffers %s / %s FE)
tooltip.potato_s_t.micro_crusher:
Crushing recipes are in JEI (a redstone signal shuts it down).
Internal buffer: 2500 FE.
(Ores, raw lithium and quartz match by c: common tags, so other mods' equivalents count too)
gui.potato_s_t.micro_crusher.status.disa: Shut down: redstone signal present (any signal stops it)
gui.potato_s_t.micro_crusher.status.inva: Cannot crush: no recipe for this item
gui.potato_s_t.micro_crusher.status.no_p: Not enough power: it needs a continuous supply
gui.potato_s_t.micro_crusher.status.outp: Output slots are full, waiting for space
tooltip.potato_s_t.hydraulic_press:
Presses mineral ingots into the matching plates.
Draws 400 FE/t and turns out one plate every 3 seconds.
Accepts copper, iron, nickel, cobalt, silver, aluminium and steel.
Also: 12 Bitumen -> 1 Asphalt Block (purely decorative, but it does look good).
A redstone signal halts it; progress is kept.
Full recipe list in JEI.
gui.potato_s_t.hydraulic_press.status.no: Not enough power: continuous supply needed
gui.potato_s_t.hydraulic_press.status.ou: Output slot is full, waiting for space
tooltip.potato_s_t.salt_decomposer:
Takes sea salt apart to get sodium chloride.
Feed in 64 Sea Salt, and 40 seconds later 1 Sodium Chloride comes out.
60% chance to return all 64 Sea Salt; a separate 5% chance of one random raw ore as a bonus.
Draws 20 FE/t and stores only 20 FE, so the supply must be continuous.
A redstone signal halts it; progress is kept.
gui.potato_s_t.jei.raw_ore_chance: %s%% chance of one random raw ore as a bonus
gui.potato_s_t.salt_decomposer.status.no: Not enough power: continuous supply needed
gui.potato_s_t.salt_decomposer.status.ou: Output slots are full, waiting for space
tooltip.potato_s_t.low_generator:
Burns coal or charcoal to make power.
Each piece of fuel burns for 45 seconds at 100 FE/t.
Internal storage is 1000 FE; burning pauses while it is full, so no fuel is wasted.
A redstone signal halts it.
tooltip.potato_s_t.electric_blast_furnac:
Assembled from a 3x3x3 structure.
Build the shell, then sneak-right-click empty-handed to form it - the anchor can be either a vanilla blast furnace or this mod's own controller.
Hold a wrench and sneak-right-click to take it apart.
12 input slots and 32 output slots; each slot finishes in 10 seconds, at 800 FE per item.
Iron Dust + Carbon Dust -> High Carbon Steel; Iron Dust + Gravel -> Magnet (drop them into any two input slots and it pairs them up on its own).
On top of this mod's ore processing, anything a vanilla blast furnace can smelt works here too.
gui.potato_s_t.ebf.invalid: Structure invalid: layer %s, row %s, column %s should be %s
tooltip.potato_s_t.alloy_smelter:
How to lay out the Alloy Smelter (the controller is the cell marked 7 on the blueprint: layer 2, front row, rightmost)
1 Heat-Resistant Metal Block  2 Common Metal Block  3 Heater  4 Blast Furnace
5 Wiring Block  6 Heat Sink  7 Alloy Smelter Controller  0 Empty
Layer 1 (bottom) | Layer 2
2222 | 5115
2332 | 4004
2332 | 4004
2332 | 4004
2222 | 6117
Layer 3 | Layer 4 (top)
1111 | 0110
1001 | 0110
1001 | 0110
1001 | 0110
1111 | 0110
Build all 4 layers to the blueprint (58 cells to check: the base, the three-high wall and those two columns of Heat-Resistant Metal Block on the roof) and make sure the shell carries at least 1 Wiring Block; then it activates on its own (the inside is up to you, and the rest of the roof does not matter).
Right-clicking the controller also activates it, and it will tell you which cell is missing. Only once it is active does right-clicking open the GUI.
5 input slots that take ingots only, 3 output slots, 2 consumption slots (they take whatever a recipe names as its consumable); 32768 FE of storage, and power comes in through the port alone. Four recipes: Light Titanium Alloy / Hard Titanium Alloy / Star Steel Ingot (netherite + 4 high carbon steel + cobalt + silver + copper, plus 1 deepslate cobalt ore and 1 end crystal, 12000 FE/t) / Vibranium Ingot (hard titanium alloy + 8 thermal metal + 2 high carbon steel + 3 silver ingots + 12 gold ingots, plus 1 raw vibranium + 2 netherite scraps, 14500 FE/t).
gui.potato_s_t.alloy_smelter.invalid: Gap in the shell: layer %s, row %s, column %s is %s (at %s %s %s) - this cell needs a machine block
gui.potato_s_t.alloy_smelter.no_port: No Wiring Block anywhere on the shell, so no power can get in: the shell needs at least 1
gui.potato_s_t.alloy_smelter.name: Alloy Smelting Furnace
tooltip.potato_s_t.oil_pump:
Only runs in the Ocean Oilfield biome - anywhere else it shuts down.
The column below must be water: count the waterlogged chains straight down from the machine, and that count is n (at most 64 blocks).
Draws 8n² + 80n FE/t and produces 10n mB/s; at n=10 that is 1600 FE/t and 100 mB/s.
The 25-bucket tank is output-only: pipes and fluid pumps can drain it, nothing pours in.
Every 25-80 buckets pumped, the ocean oilfield in a 10x10 chunk area centred on the machine turns into the surrounding ocean (frozen / warm / temperate ...).
⚠ That area includes the machine itself, so after one conversion move it to whatever oilfield is left.
gui.potato_s_t.oil_pump.status.no_power: Not enough power: 8n² + 80n FE per tick (n = waterlogged chains below)
gui.potato_s_t.oil_pump.status.output_fu: The 25-bucket tank is full; drain it with pipes or a fluid pump
gui.potato_s_t.oil_pump.status.not_oilfi: Not in the Ocean Oilfield biome - this machine only runs there
gui.potato_s_t.oil_pump.status.no_chain: No waterlogged chains below: hang chains straight down from the machine, under water
tooltip.potato_s_t.lithium_battery_plant:
Four inputs, each slot takes an either/or: raw manganese/raw aluminium, nickel ingot/raw nickel, lithium carbonate, cobalt ingot/raw cobalt.
Sulfuric acid: 1 mB per tick, so 600 mB for one 30-second batch (the tank holds 800 mB, enough for a whole batch).
One batch produces a single Lithium Battery Component; the four inputs are consumed on the last tick only.
⚠ This machine uses no power at all - it is chemistry, not electricity. A redstone signal stops it (progress is kept).
gui.potato_s_t.lithium_battery_plant.sta: Not enough sulfuric acid: 1 mB per tick (600 mB per batch)
Missing inputs: raw manganese/raw aluminium, nickel/raw nickel, lithium carbonate, cobalt/raw cobalt
advancements.potato_s_t.new_beginning.de: Build the Micro Crusher - it grinds ore into dust, and everything else stands on it
advancements.potato_s_t.stronger_power.d: Electricity makes magnetism, magnetism makes electricity... don't ask me why wires can carry power
tooltip.potato_s_t.hydrodesulfurization_:
Per batch: 16 Bitumen + 1000 mB Hydrogen -> 10 seconds -> 1 Sulfur
Hydrogen tank holds 4000 mB: feed it by pipe or pump, or right-click the machine with a hydrogen-filled gas tank.
The bitumen slot on the left takes bitumen only. A redstone signal halts it (progress kept).
⚠ This machine draws no power at all - it runs on chemistry, not on your electricity bill
gui.potato_s_t.hydrodesulfurization_cham: Output slot is full, waiting for space
Not enough hydrogen: 1000 mB per batch (right-click the machine with a hydrogen tank to pour it in)
Cannot pour in: %s (hydrogen only; it may also be a full tank / the wrong fluid)
tooltip.potato_s_t.air_separator:
Every 30 seconds: 8 mB Nitrogen + 2 mB Oxygen - the raw material is air, and there is no shortage of that.
Draws 200 FE/t, stores 5000 FE.
The two tanks are output-only: pipes and pumps can draw from them, but nothing can be poured or piped in, not even by hand.
A redstone signal halts it (progress kept).
tooltip.potato_s_t.ammonia_synthesis_cha:
Per tick: 1 mB Nitrogen + 1 mB Hydrogen + 200 FE -> 1 mB Ammonia
The catalyst slot takes Iron Dust (it is not consumed, just leave it there).
The gas tank slots under the input tanks push nitrogen and hydrogen into the machine at 50 mB/t.
The gas tank slot under the output tank runs the other way: 50 mB/t, putting ammonia into a tank.
Pumps can only bring nitrogen and hydrogen in, and take ammonia out. A redstone signal halts it.
gui.potato_s_t.air_separator.status.no_p: Not enough power: 200 FE per tick
gui.potato_s_t.air_separator.status.outp: A tank is full (this batch of nitrogen or oxygen will not fit), waiting for a pump
Not enough power: 200 FE per tick
Ammonia tank is full, waiting for a pump or a fresh tank
Not enough hydrogen (input tank is empty: hook up a pump or top it up from a gas tank)
Not enough nitrogen (input tank is empty: hook up a pump or top it up from a gas tank)
The catalyst slot needs Iron Dust (not consumed)
gui.potato_s_t.jei.catalyst: Needs Iron Dust as a catalyst (not consumed)
tooltip.potato_s_t.combustion_chamber:
The fuel slot takes anything a vanilla furnace burns (Lava Bucket 10 s, Diesel / Gasoline Bucket 30 s, everything else 3 s).
One batch of fuel + 10 mB Oxygen starts the reaction; while it runs it feeds 800 power per tick to the Power Capturer (diesel 1200 / gasoline 1000) => just place it next to the Capturer.
Logs -> 10 mB Carbon Dioxide + 1 Charcoal; Diesel / Gasoline Buckets -> 200 mB Carbon Dioxide + 50 mB Water; anything else -> 5 mB Carbon Dioxide.
The oxygen tank is input-only (pipe in, or right-click with a gas tank); the carbon dioxide and water tanks are output-only (pump them out). A redstone signal halts it.
gui.potato_s_t.combustion_chamber.status: This item will not burn (vanilla furnace fuels only)
The carbon dioxide or water tank is full, pump it out
Not enough oxygen: 10 mB per reaction
The byproduct slot is full (clear room for charcoal / empty buckets)
gui.potato_s_t.combustion_chamber.pour.r: Cannot pour in: the oxygen tank takes oxygen only (it currently holds %s)
tooltip.potato_s_t.acidic_reaction_chamb:
Four input tanks (1000 mB each): Carbon Dioxide / Oxygen / Ammonia / Water; three product tanks: Carbonic Acid / Nitric Acid / Sulfuric Acid.
Pick a recipe with the buttons: (1) 10 mB Carbon Dioxide + 1 mB Water -> 1 mB Carbonic Acid  (2) 1 mB Oxygen + 1 mB Ammonia -> 1 mB Nitric Acid
(3) 10 Sulfur + 100 mB Water -> 100 mB Sulfuric Acid (one batch takes 5 seconds, and the materials are only consumed at the very end)
All recipes draw 500 FE/t with a 12400 FE buffer (the supply must be continuous). A redstone signal halts it.
Friendly advice: whatever comes out of here, do not drink it.
gui.potato_s_t.acidic_reaction_chamber.s: Not enough power: 500 FE per tick
The product tanks are full, pump them out
Not enough sulfur for the reaction (10 needed)
Not enough fluid input (an input tank this recipe needs is empty: hook up a pump or use a gas tank)
gui.potato_s_t.acidic_reaction_chamber.r: Carbonic Acid: 10 mB Carbon Dioxide + 1 mB Water per tick -> 1 mB Carbonic Acid
Nitric Acid: 1 mB Oxygen + 1 mB Ammonia per tick -> 1 mB Nitric Acid
Sulfuric Acid: one batch of 10 Sulfur + 100 mB Water -> 100 mB Sulfuric Acid (5 seconds)
Hydrochloric Acid: 10 mB Hydrogen + 10 mB Chlorine + 5 mB Water per tick -> 5 mB Hydrochloric Acid
tooltip.potato_s_t.star_steel_axe.1: No durability loss at night; Haste I while held. 1192 durability, diamond mining level
tooltip.potato_s_t.star_steel_axe.2: Shift + right-click: costs 120 durability to send a 6-block-wide shockwave along your facing (15 s cooldown)
tooltip.potato_s_t.star_steel_axe.3:
The shockwave fells every log, stripped log and leaf in its path; it dies when it meets a block the axe cannot mine, or after 10 s without touching wood.
In the End it also deals 10 + 0.5n ranged damage (n is your own base damage)
tooltip.potato_s_t.vibranium_set:
Vibranium set: unbreakable, enchantment weight 2 - the lowest in the game, so the enchanting table rarely offers anything good - and a built-in glint.
All four pieces: Resistance I at all times (any hour, any dimension) and immunity to fall damage; immune to projectiles (incoming ones bounce back at half speed); explosion damage halved; immune to all knockback.
10% of the hits you take are returned in full to whoever dealt them - anyone killed by that gets kicked a steel plate as their death message.
(Textures currently borrow the vanilla iron set)
tooltip.potato_s_t.titanium_alloy_set: Titanium Alloy set: enchantment weight 25 (gold is 22) - it takes enchantments better than gold, and takes hits better too
tooltip.potato_s_t.star_steel_set:
Star Steel set: every piece grants Resistance I at night (more pieces still only I), and gear worn at night takes no durability damage. The helmet also grants Night Vision I (4 s at a time, topped up while worn).
All four pieces: no durability loss in the End; Overworld at night - Strength I, Resistance II, Absorption III for 10 s every 45 s; the End - Regeneration I, Resistance III, Strength II, Absorption VI for 12 s every 15 s.
The Absorption is a one-shot shield on a timer: no refill until the current one runs out or is knocked empty.
Void damage teleports you to the nearest block within 20x20 (you land safely); with no block at all, it swaps you with a nearby mob
message.potato_s_t.star_steel_void_block: Star Steel set: teleported onto the nearest block
message.potato_s_t.star_steel_void_swap: Star Steel set: no block nearby, swapped places with a mob
message.potato_s_t.star_steel_void_faile: Star Steel set: no block and no mob to swap with
advancements.potato_s_t.acid.description: Carbonic / Nitric / Sulfuric / Hydrochloric - all four acids are made here
advancements.potato_s_t.acid.title: Acidic Reaction Chamber
advancements.potato_s_t.alloy_smelter.de: Controller + power port + furnace body: three metal plates + a capacitor + a heater + a heat sink - where the alloy line begins
advancements.potato_s_t.ammonia.descript: The Air Separator gives nitrogen; nitrogen + hydrogen become ammonia in the Synthesis Chamber (the raw material for nitric acid)
advancements.potato_s_t.ammonia.title: Synthesising Ammonia
advancements.potato_s_t.blast_furnace.de: A 3×3×3 multiblock: put a vanilla blast furnace or the controller on the front and wall it in, then right-click the controller for a self-check
advancements.potato_s_t.capacitor.descri: Copper Ingot + Aluminum Plate + Silver Plate = Capacitor; the Electric Blast Furnace, Alloy Smelter and Solar Panel all want one
advancements.potato_s_t.capacitor.title: Build a Capacitor
advancements.potato_s_t.combustion.descr: One batch of fuel + 10 mB Oxygen -> Carbon Dioxide; burn logs in it and you get charcoal on the side
advancements.potato_s_t.combustion.title: Combustion Chamber
advancements.potato_s_t.crushing.descrip: The crusher grinds ingots and ore into dust: Iron Dust + Carbon Dust is what steel is made of (carbon dust comes from coal or charcoal)
advancements.potato_s_t.crushing.title: Ground to Dust
advancements.potato_s_t.distillation.des: Controller + Operator: split crude oil into diesel, gasoline, naphtha, LPG and bitumen
advancements.potato_s_t.electrolyzer.des: Electrolyzer: water + power -> oxygen + hydrogen; add sea salt and you get chlorine + hydrogen instead
advancements.potato_s_t.first_power.desc: A simple power source, convenient and good enough - feed it coal or charcoal, then run the power to your machines with terminals
advancements.potato_s_t.fuel.description: Two liquid fuels, both for the Combustion Chamber (diesel 1200 power, gasoline 1000)
advancements.potato_s_t.fuel.title: Diesel and Gasoline
advancements.potato_s_t.gas_handling.des: Gas tanks hold gases, oil buckets hold liquids; the Filling Machine fills both
advancements.potato_s_t.hard_alloy.descr: Light Titanium Alloy + High Carbon Steel + Nickel Ingot -> Hard Titanium Alloy
advancements.potato_s_t.hard_alloy.title: Hard Titanium Alloy
advancements.potato_s_t.light_alloy.desc: Aluminum Ingot + Titanium Ingot + Silver Ingot -> Light Titanium Alloy (Alloy Smelter, 30 seconds per batch)
advancements.potato_s_t.music_disc_anvil: Redstone + Titanium Ingot + Anvil = a music disc. That is all there is to it
advancements.potato_s_t.music_disc_jasmi: Soul Lantern + Block of Raw Gold + Torchflower = another disc. Ah, what a beautiful jasmine flower
advancements.potato_s_t.oil.description: Take an oil bucket to a surface oilfield and scoop up some crude oil (an empty bucket does not count)
advancements.potato_s_t.oil.title: Oil
advancements.potato_s_t.pressing.descrip: The Hydraulic Press flattens ingots into plates - iron, copper and aluminium plates are the universal parts of every machine
advancements.potato_s_t.pressing.title: Pressed into Plates
advancements.potato_s_t.stable_block.des: High Carbon Steel / Hard Titanium Alloy / Block of Gold in a 3x3 -> Stable Metal Block (the Acidic Reaction Chamber needs it)
advancements.potato_s_t.steel.descriptio: Iron Dust + Carbon Dust into the Electric Blast Furnace -> High Carbon Steel; steel is the skeleton of nearly everything that follows
advancements.potato_s_t.steel.title: Thus Is Steel Tempered
advancements.potato_s_t.sulfur.descripti: Bitumen + hydrogen into the Hydrodesulfurization Chamber -> Sulfur (the raw material for sulfuric acid)
advancements.potato_s_t.sulfur.title: Sulfur Out of Bitumen
advancements.potato_s_t.titanium.descrip: Crush raw titanium into titanium dust first, then run the dust through the Electric Blast Furnace -> Titanium Ingot
advancements.potato_s_t.titanium.title: Titanium
advancements.potato_s_t.titanium_tools.d: Light Titanium Alloy + sticks -> Titanium Alloy sword and pickaxe
advancements.potato_s_t.wiring.descripti: Terminal Blocks are your wiring: link two with a Copper Wire Spool (the Power Cable Spool for the power network), sneak-right-click to switch input / output
advancements.potato_s_t.wiring.title: Wired Up
The Fluid Pump stores nothing, only moves fluid into a destination that accepts it, and can drain sources; the Exchanger turns an empty bucket into the one matching the 1000 mB in its tank
Paper + Capacitor + Common Metal Block + Lithium Battery Part -> Ternary Polymer Lithium Battery; 4M FE per block, stack it like a pyramid, terminals on the bottom only
advancements.potato_s_t.lithium_battery_: Sulfuric Acid in (1 mB/tick, 600 mB a batch) and one item per slot: raw manganese or aluminium, nickel, lithium carbonate, cobalt - a Lithium Battery Part every 30 s
advancements.potato_s_t.oil_pump.descrip: An Oil Pump in an Ocean Oilfield: the chain in the water below is the well depth n - 8n²+80n FE/t in, 10n mB/s out, 25B tank out only
advancements.potato_s_t.oil_pump.title: Oil From Beneath the Sea
advancements.potato_s_t.salt.description: The Salt Dryer needs no input - just leave it out for Sea Salt, faster with power; salt + water in the Electrolyzer gives chlorine, or 64 salt in the Decomposer for sodium chloride in 40 s
advancements.potato_s_t.salt.title: Salt From the Sea
advancements.potato_s_t.star_steel.descr: Alloy Smelter, one batch: Netherite + 4 High Carbon Steel + Cobalt + Silver + Copper + Deepslate Cobalt Ore + Ender Crystal -> 3 Star Steel Ingots (12000 FE/t, 30 s)
advancements.potato_s_t.star_steel.title: Forge the Star Steel
advancements.potato_s_t.star_steel_armor: Helmet 5 + Chestplate 8 + Leggings 7 + Boots 4 = 24 Star Steel Ingots - wear all four and you have the toughest set in this mod
advancements.potato_s_t.starfall.descrip: Right-click to cast a Starfall: 4 durability, one per throw, a 30 s countdown you can cancel in the first 10 s - then a meteor at y=200, power 7~20, fire and 3 Raw Vibranium
advancements.potato_s_t.starfall.title: Call Down a Star
tooltip.potato_s_t.star_chart.1: Right-click to cycle the Overworld skybox (sneak-right-click to go back)
tooltip.potato_s_t.star_chart.2: Cycles through four star charts and the vanilla sky; the choice is stored in the book
tooltip.potato_s_t.star_chart.3: Only you see it - it does not change anyone else's sky
tooltip.potato_s_t.starfall_pendant.1: Right-click: call a meteor down on your position. It falls from y=200 after 30 s
tooltip.potato_s_t.starfall_pendant.2: Right-click again within the first 10 s to cancel; after that it is locked and everyone sees the countdown and your coordinates
tooltip.potato_s_t.starfall_pendant.3: Impact: an explosion of power 7-20 (with fire) plus a spray of raw ores - the higher the power, the better and the more
tooltip.potato_s_t.starfall_pendant.4: · 7-12: raw iron / raw copper · 13+: any raw ore · 15+: 3 extra raw vibranium
tooltip.potato_s_t.starfall_pendant.5: 4 uses in total; cannot be enchanted
tooltip.potato_s_t.diesel_generator_cont:
How to lay out the Diesel Generator (the controller is the cell marked 9: layer 1, front row, centre)
1 Heat-Resistant Metal Block  2 Common Metal Block  3 Fluid Pump  4 Low-Tier Generator
5 Combustion Chamber  6 Block of Copper  7 Copper Grate  8 Wiring Block  9 Diesel Generator Controller
Layer 1 (bottom) | Layer 2
1 3 1 | 2 1 2
1 4 1 | 6 7 6
1 5 1 | 6 7 6
1 4 1 | 6 7 6
1 9 1 | 2 8 2
With the controller's facing as the front, the machine runs 5 rows back and 2 layers up - not a single cell less.
Copper blocks and grates: any oxidation level, waxed or not (all 16 count).
Once complete, the Wiring Block directly above the controller becomes a port (same texture, drops back as a Wiring Block) - and that is the only place power comes out.
GUI: an 8000 mB diesel tank and a status lamp; 1 mB of diesel per tick makes 7200 FE; a redstone signal halts it.
Getting diesel in: hook up a pump (controller or port), or right-click the controller with a Diesel Bucket or an oil bucket holding diesel.
⚠ The Fluid Pump / two Low-Tier Generators / Combustion Chamber inside stay as they are - they are not consumed.
gui.potato_s_t.diesel_generator.status.e: Diesel tank is empty: pump it in, or right-click with a diesel bucket
gui.potato_s_t.diesel_generator.status.o: Power has nowhere to go: the buffer is full - put an input terminal or a copper wire next to the port
gui.potato_s_t.diesel_generator.status.n: Structure incomplete: hold Shift for the blueprint (the missing cells are printed in chat)
gui.potato_s_t.diesel_generator.invalid: Gap in the structure: layer %s, row %s, column %s should be %s, but it is %s (at %s %s %s)
gui.potato_s_t.diesel_generator.pour.emp: The container in your hand is empty
gui.potato_s_t.diesel_generator.pour.rej: Cannot pour in: %s (this machine only burns diesel)
gui.potato_s_t.diesel_generator.pour.ful: The diesel tank cannot take it: the tank is full, or this whole bucket (1000 mB) does not fit
